code: src = r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3 """CI checker for SRT captions against declared adult numeric limits at 24 fps. Usage: python3 check_captions.py CAPTIONS.srt Exit 0: every cue passes (including an empty file). Exit 1: at least one cue fails. Exit 2: usage error or input that is not valid SRT (message on stderr, no stdout). All comparisons use exact integer milliseconds; no floating point tolerance. """ import json import re import sys FPS = 24 MAX_CPS = 20 # displayed characters per second (inclusive) MAX_CPL = 42 # displayed characters per line (inclusive) MAX_LINES = 2 MIN_DUR_NUM, MIN_DUR_DEN = 5000, 6 # 5/6 s = 5000/6 ms (inclusive) MAX_DUR_MS = 7000 # inclusive GAP_FRAMES = 2 # 2 frames at 24 fps = 2000/24 ms (inclusive) TS = r"(\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2}),(\d{3})" TIMING = re.compile(r"^" + TS + r"[ \t]+-->[ \t]+" + TS + r"[ \t]*$") TAGS = re.compile(r"<[^>]*>|\{\\[^}]*\}") class InputError(Exception): pass def to_ms(h, m, s, ms, lineno): h, m, s, ms = int(h), int(m), int(s), int(ms) if m > 59 or s > 59: raise InputError(f"line {lineno}: invalid timestamp") return ((h * 60 + m) * 60 + s) * 1000 + ms def parse(text): if text.startswith("\ufeff"): text = text[1:] text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n") lines = text.split("\n") cues = [] i, n = 0, len(lines) while i < n: if lines[i].strip() == "": i += 1 continue ident = lines[i] if i + 1 >= n: raise InputError(f"line {i + 1}: cue identifier {ident!r} without timing line") m = TIMING.match(lines[i + 1]) if not m: raise InputError(f"line {i + 2}: expected 'HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm'") g = m.groups() start = to_ms(*g[:4], i + 2) end = to_ms(*g[4:], i + 2) if end < start: raise InputError(f"line {i + 2}: end time before start time") i += 2 body = [] while i < n and lines[i] != "": body.append(lines[i]) i += 1 shown = [] for raw in body: t = TAGS.sub("", raw).rstrip() if t.strip(): shown.append(t) cues.append((start, end, shown)) return cues def check(cues): out = [] failed = 0 for idx, (start, end, shown) in enumerate(cues): dur = end - start lengths = [len(t) for t in shown] chars = sum(lengths) issues = set() if dur > 0 and chars * 1000 > MAX_CPS * dur: issues.add("cps") if any(L > MAX_CPL for L in lengths): issues.add("line_length") if len(shown) > MAX_LINES: issues.add("line_count") if dur * MIN_DUR_DEN < MIN_DUR_NUM or dur > MAX_DUR_MS: issues.add("duration") if idx + 1 < len(cues): gap = cues[idx + 1][0] - end if gap < 0: issues.add("overlap") elif gap * FPS < GAP_FRAMES * 1000: issues.add("gap") if issues: failed += 1 out.append({ "cue": idx + 1, "start_ms": start, "end_ms": end, "characters": chars, "line_lengths": lengths, "issues": sorted(issues), }) return { "standard": "declared-adult-numeric-limits", "fps": FPS, "total": len(out), "passed": len(out) - failed, "failed": failed, "cues": out, } def main(argv): if len(argv) != 2: sys.stderr.write("usage: check_captions.py CAPTIONS.srt\n") return 2 try: with open(argv[1], "rb") as fh: data = fh.read() cues = parse(data.decode("utf-8")) except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, InputError) as exc: sys.stderr.write(f"error: {exc}\n") return 2 report = check(cues) sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n") return 1 if report["failed"] else 0 if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv)) ''' open('/work/check_captions.py','w',encoding='utf-8').write(src) import subprocess r=subprocess.run(['python3','/work/check_captions.py','/inputs/captions.srt'],capture_output=True,text=True) print(r.returncode,repr(r.stdout),repr(r.stderr)) tests={ 'empty':'', 'bom':'\ufeff7\r\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,834\r\nhi {\\an8}x \r\n \r\n lead\r\n\r\n9\r\n00:00:00,917 --> 00:00:07,917\r\nok\r\n', 'bounds':'1\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,833\nab\n\n2\n00:00:00,916 --> 00:00:00,916\nx\n\n3\n00:00:00,900 --> 00:00:08,000\n'+'a'*43+'\nb\nc\n\n4\n00:00:08,083 --> 00:00:09,000\n'+'Ã©'*20+'\n', 'cps':'1\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:01,000\n'+'a'*20+'\n\n2\n00:00:02,000 --> 00:00:03,000\n'+'a'*21+'\n', } for k,v in tests.items(): open('/work/t.srt','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='').write(v) r=subprocess.run(['python3','/work/check_captions.py','/work/t.srt'],capture_output=True,text=True) print(k,r.returncode,r.stdout,repr(r.stderr)) os.remove('/work/t.srt'); print(os.listdir('/work'), os.path.getsize('/work/check_captions.py'))
